name: Internal Void Segmentation and Porosity Analysis
description:
Isolate the internal voids (holes) within the particles of the 'Blobs' sample image using binary image arithmetic.

Workflow:
1. Open the 'Blobs' sample (File > Open Samples > Blobs).
2. Convert to a binary mask (Image > Adjust > Threshold). Use the default method and apply.
3. Create a 'Filled' version of the mask (Process > Binary > Fill Holes).
4. Use Image Calculator (Process > Image Calculator) to subtract the Original Mask from the Filled Mask (Filled - Original).
   - This operation leaves ONLY the internal holes as foreground.
5. Save the resulting 'holes-only' image to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/void_mask.tif'.

The final image should show the internal holes as white objects on a black background, with the main particle bodies removed.
